beats.say: In 2000, Netflix offered to sell itself to Blockbuster for $50 million.
Back then, Netflix was tiny. It mailed DVDs in red envelopes.
Blockbuster had thousands of video stores.
So the Netflix founders flew to Dallas to make the deal.
Blockbuster laughed them out of the room.
Ten years later, Blockbuster went bankrupt.
Netflix is now worth hundreds of billions of dollars.
And there's only one Blockbuster left, in Bend, Oregon.
